notes: Account background: B2C e-comm personalization platform, heavy seasonal burst traffic (campaign spikes, flash sales).
Primary requirement: guarantee <50ms p50 tail for recommendation calls; tolerate up to 75ms p95 but DO NOT accept queueing that introduces >200ms added latency.
AE notes: very technical procurement team, long list of perf tests required. asked for sustained 10k TPS for short bursts and baseline 1k TPS.
SE feedback: their KV cache pattern + short prompt lengths mean high qps; current hosted offers looked fine for baseline but not for 10k burst without pre-warmed reserved capacity.
Security: SSO + audit logs required, legal asked for encryption-at-rest via KMS and data residency in US/EU depending on customer segment.

POC history: ran small dedicated POC in May; hit queueing at 4k sustained with our default autoscale config. SE suggested config changes (higher pre-warm, adjusted batching), but finance pushed back on incremental cost.
Customer quote: "We can't risk queueing during promo windows — even small tail increases lose revenue."
Competitive pressure: evaluating InferCore who offered committed burst credits and a strict burst SLA — procurement favored predictable billing model.
Engagement status: stalled since July after finance froze spend; champion (Head of ML Ops) moved teams -> no internal owner to push purchase. Outreach attempts unresponsive (calls/emails).
Suggested workaround previously proposed: 3-node dedicated pool + burst buffer, scheduled pre-warm windows around campaigns, and fallback to smaller model variant for non-critical traffic.
Decision: marked at risk; procurement leaning to competitor for committed burst guarantees.
